title: Identify the standard form
text: The hyperbola is in the form y = a/(x - p) + q, where p shifts the graph horizontally and q shifts it vertically.

title: Find where the function is undefined
text: The vertical asymptote occurs at x = p. In g(x) = 3/(x - 2) + 1, we have p = 2, so the vertical asymptote is x = 2.
